title: Marketing
learning_outcomes: Explain audience and positioning in the context of marketing.
Compare and distinguish acquisition channels in the context of marketing.
Apply funnel metrics in the context of marketing.
Evaluate and justify decisions about marketing experiments in the context of marketing.

lessons.title: Audience and positioning
lessons.outcome: Explain audience and positioning in the context of marketing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving audience and positioning; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to campaign test brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain audience and positioning from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of audience and positioning; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Acquisition channels
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish acquisition channels in the context of marketing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving acquisition channels; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to campaign test brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain acquisition channels from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of acquisition channels; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Funnel metrics
lessons.outcome: Apply funnel metrics in the context of marketing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving funnel metrics; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to campaign test brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain funnel metrics from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of funnel metrics; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Marketing experiments
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about marketing experiments in the context of marketing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving marketing experiments; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to campaign test brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain marketing experiments from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of marketing experiments; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of audience and positioning; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of acquisition channels; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of funnel metrics; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of marketing experiments; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practitioner with relevant business, technology or privacy expertise.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
